description: Admission of Children to Grade One of Schools
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-06-22 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Circular instructions are issued for each year regarding the admission of children to Grade One in government schools, and its objective is to make provisions so as to ensure equitable access to education with transparency and minimal irregularities. The new circular has been prepared, taking into account the views and suggestions of the Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery or Corruption, the Human Rights Commission of Sri Lanka, principals and education authorities, and also focusing on new education reforms. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister, in her capacity as the Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education, to issue a new circular containing the relevant provisions and instructions for the admission of children to Grade One in government schools from the year 2027 onwards, was approved by the Cabinet.
